parameters.name: CdnType
parameters.description:
The service type of the accelerated domain. Valid values:

- **web**: small files and images.

- **download**: large file downloads.

- **video**: VOD acceleration.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The domain names to add to CDN. Separate multiple domains with a comma.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group. If you omit this parameter, the system automatically uses the ID of the default resource group.

parameters.name: Scope
parameters.description:
The service area. Valid values:

- **domestic**: Chinese mainland only.

- **overseas**: Global (excluding Chinese mainland).

- **global**: Global.

parameters.name: TopLevelDomain
parameters.description: The root domain name, such as example.com.
